name: moving_markup
chapter: Moving markup (l5_valgrind): a ledge on the rim of the turning cog wheel 7312 caught by a standing jump, ridden round, let go
note: docs/GAMEPLAY.md 'Moving markup'. Cog wheel 7312 (ar_pu_cog_wheel_level_1a) carries four ledge items (markup ids 1614-1617) on its rim, 739 over the floor, and turns for about 9 s after the unit starts (267 units/s at her hands' radius). The gate cinematic's placement puts her by the gate on the first tick, 20 s on foot from the wheel, so the teleport fixture stands her by the rim (set-up); the catch, the ride and the let-go are input.

expect.note: carried by the wheel with no input: 267 units/s
falling she keeps the rim's speed (the tick she lets go also steps her 20 off the wall)
she leaves with the rim's velocity: carried on while she falls 240 to the floor
